notes.title: From the Creator of Eternamine | Gridle
notes.content:
Hi everyone 😄
I just thought I'd post a quick update to let you know about my next game I'm working on, "Gridle".



 📌In Gridle, you manage an RPG-party to fight waves of enemies for you. Your job is to upgrade, heal, reorganize and unlock skills for your party member to ensure their survival and to help them progress through all the levels of the game.  

📌Gridle features a rebirth system with a massive "Knowledge-Tree", minigames, Offline progression and lots more!  



If you've enjoyed Eternamine, then I'm sure you'll like Gridle as well.

notes.title: Eternamine 2 year anniversary | Update 2.4 released!
notes.content:
Content & Additions
Player skins
Player skins are finally here! I know you've all been wanting it (I've seen and heard your requests) and here they are! Player skins can now be purchased and equipped by talking to the "Player Master". Some skins can be bought for trophies (like other skins). Additionally, the bi-monthly collection events each have their own exclusive skin. There is also an exclusive player skin that can be obtained by winning a monthly contest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141036/fa3b308ba0e37679fc8997a69be719fd3ce373dd.png

Public profiles
The boring leaderboard entries are now getting much more personality. On top of displaying just a score and a public username, the leaderboards will now also display:

 A player, pickaxe and sword skin of your choice
 A player, pickaxe and sword shader skin of your choice
 A title of your choice. Titles are automatically unlocked from certain achievements


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141036/5da7c07f70edc48b3984b47d745a50bfc84a7935.png

Contest additions
The monthly contest now has some exclusive items that you can obtain. These items can mainly be gotten from a "contest bag" obtained from the new upgrade associated with it. There are currently contest point bags as well as contest explosives. All contest items are wiped from your inventory when a new contest starts, so make sure to use them before that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141036/ed318d6e32067f7e8c7aedce37ba24222c55fa8d.png

Custom keybinds
You can now finally bind your own custom inputs both for keyboard-mouse and for controller input. This was probably a feature I should have added a long time ago but just never got around to it. Better late than never I guess :) This feature is not extremely-well tested, so please let me know if you find any issues and I will get to it as soon as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141036/8a436c8f55e33f4808abf8a7eaa3b6c919f42a3a.png

QOL/Minor Changes

 /ancientshard command have been added for the CheatZ gamemode
 Pet slots now display info of which stats are upgraded for each pet
 Dark mine ores now have much better chop particles
 Sticky bombs now count towards the "use bomb" quests. (Contest bombs also count)
 Added scrollbars to all applicable panels
 Refinery panel now shows recipes that can be done first when starting a new refinery recipe
 Fixed all issues with some buttons being wrongfully masked
 And tons (and I mean tons) of additional small UI fixes & improvements


Balance changes

 Rebirthing now has a change to give you geodes as a bonus
 The Unicorn and flamingo pets have received significant buffs to their mining speed


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug where fullscreen would be toggled every time you entered the main menu
 Fixed a bug where ability cooldown slots would mess up when in camera mode (F1)



Eternamine Supporter Pack
Eternamine has now been out for 2 years and throughout that time, the game has certainly evolved way past its original state. Throughout this development, I have kept the game at the original release price and I intend to keep it that way. However, I do believe that a slightly higher price more accurately reflects the games value and have hence decided to take a middle-road in the form of a supporter pack DLC. The Eternamine Supporter pack does not contain any additional content and only contains cosmetic additions. Hence you are not missing out any gameplay aspects if you do not want to get the supporter pack. 
The pack currently contains cosmetics in the form of

 Exclusive Titles for your public profile
 Exclusive player skins
 Exclusive shader skins
 Exclusive lobby "seasons"
 Exclusive lobby NPC stands
 A "Supporter Edition" ribbon in the main menu of the game
 An exclusive role in the Eternamine discord server

And may be updated in the future to contain even more stuff.
If you have enjoyed Eternamine and would like to further support the game while simultaneously receiving some bonus cosmetics and decorations, then please consider getting the supporter pack :)

You can find the supporter pack here: Eternamine Supporter Pack

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141036/3a5d33aaf081e332b87311e80716eb887618a45e.png

Until the next update
- Seyloj

notes.title: Eternamine 2.3 is here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone & Happy new years! 

My college studies combined with Christmas holidays as well as other projects in the works have left me quite busy recently, in spite of this I have had some time to create new features for Eternamine. While these new features aren't massive, they set the foundations to create lots of cool stuff in the future, both by me the developer and you players. This update has added & changed the following things:

Content
New chat feature
The old event text in the bottom left of the UI has been replaced with a more sophisticated chat panel. Like previously, all event texts will be displayed here but now you can see a much longer history of the messages throughout your game sessions.

This new panel also allows you to enter text as well as enter a bunch of brand new commands!
Commands
A bunch of initial commands have been added to the game, some of them are:

 /value - Check the value of all three main currencies of whichever item you're holding
 /warp - Warp to a mine/deep mine or the lobby. Command is locked by default but can be unlocked with the warp command rune (see below)
 /alias - Manage your own aliases for commands, these support command chaining, allowing a single command call to call multiple commands (using << notation).
 /timer - Call a command after a set duration, can also define repeating timers with /timerrepeating
 /say - Output text in the chat, can be combined with arguments and /setcolor to create your own unique output commands. See the official guide for this command.

And tons of more commands, all commands can be seen by using the command /help.
You can also autocomplete commands/command arguments by pressing tab as well as going through your sent messages using the arrow keys when the chat is open.

New items
Command runes have now been added and can be obtained from Geodes. These runes will permanently give you access to their respective command. There are currently 3 different command runes: Warp, Sell & SellItem

CheatZ gamemode
A new gamemode has been added which allow you unrestricted access to all commands including :

 /item - Manage items freely, give and remove whichever items you want from your inventory
 /money - Manage your money freely
 /tokens - Manage your tokens freely
 /gems - Manage your gems freely

And many more!

Contest improvement
The monthly contest has been given some well-needed improvements. They are:

 You can now see your total earned points and your current contest placement when in the contest mine
 When your contest placement changes while in the contest mine, you will receive a notification in the chat
 You can now see the results of all past monthly contests
 Issues with contest rewards not being given has been further fixed. They should no longer happen


UI improvement
Most of the UI-elements in the game (especially in the lobby) have been changed slightly to look better. You will most likely notice some changes as soon as you start playing again :)

New discord server
Previously all my game's communities have been hosted under the same discord server, but now this has changed. Eternamine now has an exclusive discord server which can be joined through this link 
In this server you can be awarded roles for winning the in-game monthly contests, share commands with 

The future of Eternamine
The development of Eternamine has gone on for over 2 years now, with with 1.5 of those years being regular content updates for the game. I now feel like I have reached a point in the game's development where most of what I wanted for the game is there. I do still love working on the game however, so I would very much now like to hear what you want from the game. Do you want more mines? Do you want more skills? New areas to explore? New abilities to unlock? Brand new features? Whatever it is, I want to hear your wishes for the game. So please do not hesitate to share your thoughts either in the Steam forums here or in the brand new discord listed above, I can't wait to hear them :)

Until the next update
- Seyloj

notes.title: Eternamine 2.2 is here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

After a summer of (trying to) relax, update 2.2 is finally ready for release. This update has added & changed the following things:

Content
Eternal mine
Contrary to its name, the Eternal rock was seemingly shattered by a powerful miner. In an attempt to replace it, the mine master started desperately searching for new mines, and he was not disappointed with his findings.

The Eternal mine is a new, fully idle mine that can be upgraded in various ways. It costs 1 Ancient shard to unlock (miners who had the Eternal rock will have it unlocked automatically). The mine can be upgraded to yield more tokens, extract more blocks, find more items and even work offline.

New items
4 New items have been added.

 Sticky bomb - Acts the same as a bomb but sticks to surfaces it touches
 Sticky dynamite - Acts the same as a dynamite but sticks to surfaces it touches
 Time orb - Use this to instantly restock the shop, geodes and start a random event
 Ancient map - Use this to instantly open a dark mine


New events
3 New events have been added

 Haunted mine (infection event)
 Asteroid struck mine (infection event)
 Ancient aura - Artifacts have an increased spawn rate


Combat changes
PvE combat has been reworked slightly.

 Enemies will now take more random routes when seeking you out. All dungeons & dark mines now have 1 enemy which can dash towards you, so be careful!
 Defeating the dungeon boss will no longer send you back to the lobby, instead it will open a random dungeon exit for you to leave through.
 Enemies can now be comboed by repeatedly attacking the same enemy (new leaderboard for highest combo)


New skills
15 New skills have been added

New achievements
7 New achievements have been added

New customization
You can now customize the loading screen background by talking to the decorator master


QOL

 You can now see the block distribution of every standard mine and deep mine
 The pet panel now has an info panel regarding your current pet level boost (from the level boost skill)
 x50 in the purchase panels has been replaced with max
 Upgrade buttons now display "buy [amount]x"
 Certain items can now be quick-used by shift+right clicking (up to 1.000 per use)
 You can now press shift to toggle the amount option in shop & upgrade panels
 The shop sell buttons now show how much you'll be selling
 Particle pages now loop 
 You can now click in your hotbar to switch the active item
 You can now zoom in/out in the skill tree
 The contest panel now displays the remaining time of the current contest


Bugs/Changes

 Fixed a bug where spam restoring your save backup could infinitely stack certain stats
 Fixed a bug where the Arcane dungeon would infinitely spawn the boss
 Fixed a bug where setting rarities to negative values caused crashed (mainly in the deep mines)
 The ability detail display now looks better, displaying stat information in a more readable way
 Dungeon vaults now have a unique opening panel
 Certain upgrades have had their icons redesigned
 Added a small tutorial of the skill tree upon first level up
 Various gameplay optimizations

notes.title: Eternamine 1 year anniversary | Update 2.1 released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Today is the day of Eternamines 1 year anniversary since release. To celebrate, a content update, Eternamine 2.1 has been released :)

Content
Collection event
Collection events are here! Every other month, a new NPC will appear and encourage you to collect a special currency (by mining & defeating enemies), this currency can be traded for items. Make sure to spend them during the month however as he will leave at the end of it.

Lobby customization
You can now customize the lobby in various ways. Setting up flags, changing the NPC stands as well as changing the seasons/general appearance of the lobby.

New skills
Added 9 new skills to the skill tree

New abilities
Added 2 new abilities. Pickaxe-throw and life-trade

New achievements
Added 26 new Achievements (one for each standard mine)

QOL

 You can now multi-buy ancient upgrades
 Added a "claim all" button for achievements
 Added a "inventory full" lock to the shop, blocking you from purchasing items that can't fit
 Hid the rarity distribution panel/upgrade in MineLock games (since all rarities are equal in MineLock)
 Added an "warning" panel to Steam related panels when Steam is not initialized
 Added a "max particles" setting




Bugs/Changes

 Fixed a bug where the bag upgrade skill had a near-zero procc chance
 Fixed an issue where certain particles would render above UI elements
 Fixed an issue where rarities could be set below 0%
 Fixed an issue where you could dash out of dungeons/dark mines
 Your pets will now periodically express themselves
 Added a boss health bar to the dungeons
 The "Shockwave" ability now deals more damage the closer to the point-of-impact an enemy is


Thank you all for playing Eternamine, your support of this game means a ton! Now let's look forward to another year of updates :)

notes.title: Eternamine 2.0 is here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! The largest update to Eternamine, "Eternamine 2.0" is finally here! This update has added & changed the following things:

Content
Multiple save files
Eternamine now has a multi-save file system. You will be able to create and play various save files in the new main menu of the game. On top of this, 4 different gamemodes and 3 game difficulties have been added, including the unique "MineLock" gamemode!

Abilities
A new ability system has been added. You can now unlock, upgrade and equip different abilities for your player, sword and pickaxe by talking with the "Player Master". All 3 categories have 3 abilities each.

Random events
Random events can now periodically happen during gameplay. There are currently 5 different random events that can happen:

 Infected mine - A random mine is infected, clearing the entire mine will give you rewards
 Pet rescue event - A lost pet appears in a random mine, finding the pet will give you rewards
 Golden chalice - A golden chalice is spawned in a random mine. Finding the chalice will give you rewards and buffs
 Upgrade discount - All upgrades are discounted for a few minutes
 Scorching furnace - All refinery recipes started during this period will immediately be 50% complete


Skill tree expansion
The skill tree has been greatly expanded. The amount of skills have been more than doubled. Total number of skills is now up to 138

New Items
A few new items have been added. Pet food, miners caches as well as cosmic money and token bags.

New upgrades
4 new upgrades have been added.

More deep mines
Tons of more deep mines have been added. Going all the way down to "Zenith Zephyr" unlocked at 5.000 prestige levels.

More achievements
Tons of more achievements have been added.

More customization

 Added shader skins for player, swords, pickaxes & pets
 Added tons of new pickaxe and sword skins
 Added 10 more pickaxe & sword particles
 You can now rename your pets
 You can now change your displayed name in the UI


More pets
4 New pets have been added. Wolf, flamingo, moose and "pet rock"...?

Creaturepedia
Added the "Creaturepedia". As you discover enemies/pets and NPC's you will now fill in their info in the "Creaturepedia".

More enemies
The creatures of the dungeons has received some backup. You will now find many more enemies in the four different dungeons. Perfect for filling out your new Creaturepedia :) 

QOL

 You can now see contest prizes at the contest master
 Added x1, x10, x25 mult button to the rarity distribution
 You can now see upgrade stats in the effective level panel
 You can now see upgrade levels in the upgrade panel
 You can now see your prestige level in the standard/deep mine panel
 Added set all max/0 to the effective level panel
 Added camera mode (Press F1 to toggle camera mode)
 Added support for various resolutions (Including ultrawide)
 You can now spend gems to instantly finish refinery recipes


Bugs/Changes

 The blockopedia has been redesigned
 Fixed various bugs related to the contest mine (Stats not resetting, rewards not being given etc.)
 The pet system has been slightly reworked, you're no longer guaranteed to get a pet you don't own. Duplicate pets will now give "pet food" which can be used to upgrade existing pets or refined into pet eggs.
 PvE has had some reworks. Sword upgrades have been nerfed. Your damage is now also dependent on far out on your sword hits an enemy (further out means more damage)
 Added 5 new stats (Quests completed, dungeons completed, pets rescued, infections cleared & chalices found)
 Added 3 new leaderboards (Deepest layer found, quests completed & dungeons completed)
 The rebirth system has been nerfed.
 Various smaller additions have been added. (wild animals, throwing coin into the lobby well, "Snowmans curse...?" and more)
 Performance improvements


An many other features and changes

I truly hope that you all enjoy this update as much as I enjoyed working on it.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W0Fh4cylxFI

notes.title: Eternamine 1.3 is here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone

The third content update for Eternamine is finally here and this one has added a lot of content and QOL changes that has had focus on replayability. This update has added & changed the following things:

Content

 A whole new mine has been discovered! This mine has a currency and upgrades that are completely separate from the main game and will reset each month. All miners in this mine will compete in a leaderboard to be the biggest earners and the best miners will win prizes at the end of each contest (each new month).
Each months contest has a specified set of upgrades and blocks.

 Added a new feature to specify the "effective level" of each upgrade in the game. This means you can specify exactly what level you want to apply to each upgrade (with the top cap being the level you have of that upgrade). Is your movement speed too high? Are you doing to much damage with your sword and want more of a challenge? Want to test mining with slammer but no bomber? Well just drag down the effective levels of those upgrades to whatever level you wish!

 All skills in the sklill tree can now be toggled on/off

 Added a bunch of new skills to the skill tree

 Added 4 new deep mines

 Added the infamous "Driller" upgrade

 A new currency "trophies" has been added. This currency is earned from completing quests and "claiming" your achievements in the lobby. Trophies are spent on buying pickaxe particles, so no more spending your hard-earned cash on them.

 Added tons of new pickaxe particles

 Some lobbies have been redesigned and expanded.




QOL

 A new option has been added to toggle both levelup panel and the text when you receive items
 Your rarity distribution is now saved
 Most lobby text has been changed from black to white for better readability
 Your entry on leaderboards is now highlighted


Balance changes

 The shop now has a limited stock for all items
 Starting autochop speed: 5 → 8
 Starting reach: 5 → 4
 Divine mystery gift now contain some new items
 The shop will now randomly restock while playing (not only on a new day)


Bugs/fixes

 Fixed an issue where shop & geodes would not restock while playing
 Fixed an issue with the refinery not resetting on rebirth
 Fixed some issues with the input system
 Fixed standard mines containing artifacts
 Fixed the UI for refinery cutting out
 Fix limitless panel being softlocked when consuming the last sigill
 Added nuke particles

notes.title: Eternamine 1.2 is here!
notes.content:

The second content update for Eternamine is finally here and this is a big one. This update has added & changed the following things:

 A new item type, geodes, are now here. These can be bought and opened and contain some really valuable items, including the new "Limitless sigils"
 Limitless sigils are new items that when used, will permanently increase the max level of an upgrade of your choice, this effect does not reset when rebirthing.
  Refinery: Items can now be refined into higher tier items, refining takes some time and only has a % chance to work. If a refine process does not work, the original item will still be consumed
 Lots of new quest types have been added
 9 New achievements have been added
 The blocks mined & enemies defeated leaderboards have been reworked and now stores the exact value
 Added a quick-open option for crates
 You can now multi-sell in the shop


Balance changes

 The starting CPS of mining has been increased from 1 CPS to 5


Bugs/fixes

 Fixed an issue where quests would overtick
 Fixed an issue where prestige'ing would not cost money
 Fixed a bug with the automine
 Fixed a bug where dark ores would not break
